messages.subject: plotGeno with cross2 data
messages.body_plain:
Hi

I need to create plots (a diagnostic plot for individuals) from plotGeno function. However, my data are in the cross2 format, not the first version.
Is there a new function implemented to plotGeno to handle with cross2 data?
Or, is there a function to convert cross2 to cross1 (first version) format?

Thanks,
Luis Arge

messages.subject: Re: plotGeno with cross2 data
messages.body_plain:
There’s not any facility for converting data from cross2 to cross1 format.
And unfortunately there’s not a direct equivalent for plotGeno to handle cross2 data.
There’s plot.calc_genoprob <https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/qtl2/html/plot_genoprob.html> for showing the genotype probabilities for a single individual,
and plot_onegeno <https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/qtl2/html/plot_onegeno.html> for showing an individuals genome-wide genotypes.

karl
